async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for the target post using the search box in the complementary section
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await searchbox.fill("I Ditched VS Code For The Open-Source VSCodium, And I Have No Regrets")
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Click the link to the post from the search results
    # Assuming the search results show the post as a link with the exact title
    post_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="I Ditched VS Code For The Open-Source VSCodium, And I Have No Regrets", exact=True)
    await post_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Use the knowledge base function to submit the comment
    # Extract the relative URL from the current page
    current_url = page.url
    # Assuming the URL is like 'http://localhost:8000/?p=...', get the path and query
    from urllib.parse import urlparse
    parsed_url = urlparse(current_url)
    page_url = parsed_url.path + parsed_url.query  # e.g., '/?p=123'
    
    result = await submit_comment_on_page(
        page=page,
        page_url=page_url,
        comment_text="This gives me a new angle to consider.",
        commenter_name="Anonymous User",
        commenter_email="user@example.com",
        commenter_website="",
        save_details=True
    )
    print(result)
